text:
incident-bot: P1 INCIDENT — elevated 5xx + high tail latency observed in ap-northeast-2 (APAC) affecting Hosted API + several Dedicated pools. Pager: @ingrid. AWS reported partial regional control-plane/API Gateway errors. Please ack and escalate if you are oncall. :rotating_light:

ingrid: ack. I'm oncall. Seeing a spike in 502/504 from ELB -> targets and higher STS latencies. Are we failing auth calls or direct model endpoints? Any early mitigation suggestions?

matt: looking now. ELB access logs show surge of CONNECT_RESET and 502 from target group for the region. CloudWatch stacked metrics show STS and API Gateway latencies increasing around 01:04Z. I'm opening an AWS support case (case# 87654321). This looks like an upstream AWS regional control-plane/auth issue, not our model runtime itself.

sara: support queue: 4 enterprise customers on Dedicated APAC pools reporting errors; one reported degraded embeddings pipeline and another seeing timeouts in chat features. Hosted API error-rate in ap-northeast-2 ~18% 5xx over last 15m, p95 latency jumped from ~1.2s to ~3.6s. Ticketing customers now; status page draft incoming.

ingrid: immediate mitigations we can do: 1) enable cross-region fallback routing for new requests, 2) mark affected Dedicated pools as degraded and allow cross-region routing / failover, 3) reduce batch sizes to avoid amplifying retries. Matt, can you apply routing override to prefer us-west-2 for new traffic from ap-northeast-2?

matt: applying now. running command:

```
./rctl route-override set --region ap-northeast-2 --fallback us-west-2 --scope hosted,dedicated --ttl 300
```

matt: done — override applied at 2087654335. Starting gradual traffic shift. Observability: sampling shows ~40% of new requests routed to us-west-2 within 60s.

alex: saw routing change. For routed requests p95 latency returned closer to baseline (~1.3s) once served from us-west-2. Note: cross-region requests will increase token egress cost and cause KV-cache misses (cold cache). Keep an eye on regional cache hit rates.

cecilia: drafting incident banner + status page update. Proposed status blurb: "We are investigating elevated 5xx and latency in ap-northeast-2. We have enabled cross-region fallback to reduce customer impact; some traffic may be routed to alternate regions." Shall I publish?

support-bot: Published status page update (incident: ap-northeast-2 partial AWS control-plane disruption) at 2087654348. Customers notified via email for affected enterprise accounts.

ingrid: short-term notes: 1) Open AWS case and escalate, 2) keep routing override in place until AWS confirms recovery, 3) don't rollback Dedicated pool configs until we validate control-plane stability, 4) coordinate oncall handoff if needed.

matt: AWS support replied: "We are investigating an issue affecting API Gateway and STS in ap-northeast-2; mitigation in progress." ETA unknown.

alex: observed downstream effects on our observability (datadog) — metrics ingestion from ap-northeast-2 has increased error rates and partial batching delays. We should avoid heavy eval or backfill jobs hitting that region.

sara: customer impact summary (quick): ~12% of requests for Hosted API in ap-northeast-2 failed, elevated retries created additional load; 4 Dedicated customers with pools in ap-northeast-2 saw ~15-25% errors on critical routes. Business-critical customers contacted.

ingrid: i'm going to hand off the incident to alex for overnight; alex you ok to take the lead and continue coordination with AWS + support? I'll be offline in ~20m.

alex: ack — taking over at 2087654360. Actions: monitor routing override metrics, keep status page updated, coordinate with eng-runtime & infra for any rollback triggers.

matt: additional temporary mitigation we rolled out: reduce long-poll timeouts for APAC storefront routes to reduce lingering connections to control-plane endpoints. Command applied:

```
./rctl config update --service storefront --timeout 8s --region ap-northeast-2
```

cecilia: status update posted: "Customers may see degraded performance in APAC; fallback to alternate regions is in effect." added note about potential cost/latency impact.

incident-bot: AWS status update received: "Partial disruption in ap-northeast-2 API Gateway / STS services — mitigation in progress" at 2087654375.

alex: AWS just marked the issue as resolved at 2087654380 per their status page: "Service normal". Observability shows 5xx rate in ap-northeast-2 falling back toward baseline over the next ~3m.

matt: beginning revert of routing override:

```
./rctl route-override delete --region ap-northeast-2 --scope hosted,dedicated
```

matt: revert applied at 2087654386. Traffic shifting back to ap-northeast-2. Monitoring p95 and 5xx for 20m before closing.

sara: support: customers notified of recovery. No escalations pending.

cecilia: drafting post-incident summary and incident timeline for page. Assigning owners for RCA: eng-runtime (model routing), eng-ml (cache warmup effects), eng-infra (routing & autoscaling).

alex: handover notes from ingrid accepted. I'll keep a watch for 30m then close the incident if stable.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Please create postmortem and link to this thread. 

cecilia: creating postmortem ticket: PM-7834 and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-infra. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow. :memo:

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging at 2087654399 (mitigations applied; AWS marked resolved).
